summary: Hyperscale Data, Inc. filed a prospectus supplement for an at-the-market issuance of up to $300 million in Class A common stock under an ATM sales agreement with Spartan Capital Securities. The stock, traded under GPUS on NYSE American, had a June 17, 2026 closing price of $0.3979 per share. Sales will be made at market prices through Spartan, which receives 3.0% commission. No escrow or trust arrangement exists. This is a routine shelf takedown for equity capital raising, not a special situation. As an ordinary securities offering, it does not fit special-situations categories.
